bagPolicy.summary: Bag rules for Lenovo Center concerts are set by the tour promoter and vary by event. Backpacks and oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clutch or wristlet up to 4.5" x 6.5" (Hurricanes and NC State events)
bagPolicy.note: Check the event page for the concert's bag rule. At Hurricanes and NC State games, parenting and medical bags are allowed after X-ray screening.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Edwards Mill Road from I-40 or Wade Avenue. The main entrance to the Lenovo Center parking lots is on the left. For detailed parking options and pricing, refer to the Parking Guide.

rideshare.note: Taxi services may be available in the drop off and pick up area located in gate C (near the TowneBank Center). Lenovo Center Rideshare offers convenient, one-stop drop-off and pick-up location across the main roadway from VIP Parking, next to Townebank Center at Carter-Finley Stadium.

concessions.note: Lenovo Center offers a variety of food and drink options including gourmet hot dogs, fresh-breaded chicken, and signature mac & cheese bowls. Special offerings include Sup Crush branded vodka drinks and Cheerwine Slushies.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Sensory Bags, Weighted Lap Pads, and Photosensitivity Glasses: Available for guests to check-out at Guest Services (Section 127) at no cost. Accessible Seating is available throughout all levels of the facility.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exit / Re-entry into Lenovo Center is NOT permitted, including for smoking.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: To purchase tickets, call 919-865-1510, or visit the NC State Ticket Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Lenovo Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.

glance.label: Bags
glance.value: Bag rules for Lenovo Center concerts are set by the tour promoter and vary by event (posted for sports events; concerts may differ)
